manifest.name: Zotero MetaFlow
manifest.description: Validate, organize and enrich reference metadata in Zotero.
manifest.author: groele

package.installationScope: Temporary installation in an isolated scaffold profile; daily user profile untouched

nativeFinal.scope: Complete native suite including abstract rules, import switches, core notification reuse, cancellation, settings, metadata, transactions, duplicates and production XPI installation
Final production XPI: abstract normalization, settings gates, automatic import and production package installation; explicit item-data reload arguments in test fixtures

limitations: Zotero 11 development builds were not rerun for this release. Compatibility metadata remains 10.0–11.x.
No macOS/Linux or exhaustive third-party coexistence validation.
Provider responses are controlled fixtures; live account permissions and availability are not certified.
Abstract paragraph boundaries and chemical fragment detection are conservative heuristics; arbitrary malformed publisher text is not guaranteed to be repaired.
